notes: Both sides take `children` and `width` above. Both panes at an 1100px viewport (the pane reports a 0px viewport when hidden; resize it first).

The brands page has no showcases: the mirror renders the 25 sketches (sketch/brands.*.json, one per logo cell of the page, drawn from the server HTML by the cell's brand classes around the preview container) as 25 previews. Ours: the docs page's 13 showcases hold 25 acme-brands in the same order.

The root carries no marker attribute: the marker is the forced-light class on the preview container. `mark` is the logo svg: ours excludes the copy button's stroke glyphs; the reference's is the frame's svg.

Ours: load http://localhost:4183/census.js with a script tag and await its onload, then await customElements.whenDefined for acme-brands and acme-button and every acme-brands's updateComplete (and its inner acme-button's) before each call.

Known lines: (1) the seven dark-mode image cells (Next.js, Turbo, Turborepo, Turbopack logotypes and symbols on black) read the broken image's alt text, drawn inline in each side's font, until the 14 logo files the corpus lacks are fetched into corpus/media (the mirror) and assets/ (ours): root, frame and force heights and widths, and the dark image's width. (2) The two spacing illustrations sit in a block cell in the reference (min-width 0px) where the logo cells are flex items (auto): our host is one column box, so those two roots read auto; the documented host-context difference.
